channels.help_alerts_description: When your elder asks for help. Loud on purpose.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{app}}
welcome.tagline: A daily nod that says I'm okay.
welcome.family_hint: For children, grandchildren and anyone who looks out for someone.
welcome.elder: Someone set this up for me
welcome.elder_hint: Your family will show you a code to connect this phone.
welcome.revoked: Your family disconnected this phone. You can set it up again below.
welcome.left: This phone is no longer in elder mode.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a code. No password needed.
signIn.not_family: Is this the elder's own phone? Go back

onboarding.title: About you
onboarding.intro: Your family sees your name. Your timezone lets us show times in yours.
onboarding.timezone_hint: Pick where you live. We suggest, but never choose for you.

family.none: You're not in a family yet. Create one, or join with a code someone sent you.
family.no_elders: No elders yet. Add the person you're looking out for.

elderPhone.heading: Their phone
elderPhone.confirm_body: {{name}}'s phone goes back to the welcome screen. You can set it up again with a new code.

addElder.title: Add an elder
addElder.checkin_note: Daily check-in: a reminder at {{remind}}, expected by {{due}}, their time. You can change this later.

pairing.title: Set up {{name}}'s phone
pairing.steps: On {{name}}'s phone, open {{app}}, choose "Someone set this up for me", then scan this code or type it in.

invites.title: Invite family
invites.intro: Anyone with this code can join your family once. It works for 48 hours.
invites.share_message: Join our family on {{app}}. Open {{link}} or enter the code {{code}}.

pin.title: Family PIN
pin.intro: Typing this PIN on an elder's phone takes it out of elder mode. Choose 4 to 8 digits your elder won't guess.
pin.not_set: No family PIN yet. Without one, you disconnect a phone from this app instead.

elder.pair_intro: Ask your family to show you the code on their phone.
elder.camera_why: The camera is only used to read your family's code.
elder.not_a_code: That isn't a Nodly code. Try again.
elder.okay_thanks: Thank you! Soon your family will see this.
elder.leave_title: Take this phone out of elder mode
elder.leave_no_pin: Ask your family to disconnect this phone in their {{app}} app.
